components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:0.75rem; min-height:60px; min-width:280px; padding:0 2rem; background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper); border:0; border-radius:999px; font-family:'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size:1.25rem; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.01em; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 0.2s var(--ease-out), transform 0.2s var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-spark { display:inline-flex; color:var(--gold); transition:transform 0.5s var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#323832; } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-spark, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible .ds-btn-spark { transform:rotate(90deg) scale(1.15); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(0.98); }

components.css: .ds-q-label { display:block; font-family:'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink); } .ds-q-label::before { content:'\201C'; } .ds-q-label::after { content:'\201D'; } .ds-q-input { display:block; width:100%; min-height:88px; margin-top:4px; padding:10px 0; background:transparent; border:0; border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink); border-radius:0; font-family:'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size:1.0625rem; line-height:1.5; color:var(--ink); resize:none; transition:box-shadow 0.2s var(--ease-out); } .ds-q-input::placeholder { color:#646a64; } .ds-q-input:focus { outline:none; box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--ink); }

components.css: .ds-stone { position:relative; height:132px; margin-top:24px; background:var(--stone); border-radius:4px; display:flex; align-items:flex-end; padding:14px 16px; font-family:'Schibsted Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stone-facts { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:0.25rem 0.5rem; margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; font-size:0.9375rem; font-weight:500; color:var(--ink); } .ds-stone-facts li + li::before { content:'\00B7'; margin-right:0.5rem; } .ds-stone-spark { position:absolute; color:var(--gold); animation:ds-sparkle-in 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both; } .ds-lg { top:-18px; right:22px; animation-delay:0.15s; } .ds-sm { top:34px; right:80px; animation-delay:0.35s; } @keyframes ds-sparkle-in { from { opacity:0; transform:scale(0.2) rotate(-60deg); } to { opacity:1; transform:scale(1) rotate(0deg); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-stone-spark { animation:none; } }

narrative.overview:
A calm, modern-zen page where nothing competes with the question. Cool paper ground, near-black ink, one solid block of sage soapstone, and a handful of soft-gold four-point sparkles: the system's single playful move. Everything else is quiet, flat, and typographic. The world deliberately sidesteps the category's mystic purple and starfields, and equally the beige spa-zen opposite.

Density is low and single-column. One grotesk family carries the whole voice, set lowercase and heavy at display sizes, matching the product's playful lowercase copy. Depth comes from solid color and weight, never from shadows, gradients, glass, or glow. The header, content, and footer share one left edge inside a narrow column, so the page reads as one straight stack on a phone and a centered stack on desktop.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper white ground, ink text, one sage stone block per screen.
Soft-gold drawn sparkles as the only ornament, and every ✨ in copy rendered as that same drawn mark.
One grotesk family (Schibsted Grotesk), lowercase, 800 weight for display.
Quoted labels in place of form chrome; underline-only fields; ink pill buttons.
Flat surfaces with no shadows, gradients, or glass.
One shared left edge for header, content, and footer.

rules.name: The Gold Is Ornament Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only as the drawn four-point sparkle and the coins. It is never text, or a fill, border, or background on UI chrome.

rules.name: The Bronze Coin Rule
rules.body: The coins are always cast gold/bronze (gold face shading to #8a6420, #7a5a1e rim, #3d2a0b symbol), never a palette color (user-pinned).

rules.name: The One Stone Rule
rules.body: A screen gets at most one sage stone block. The stone is a slab of material, not a card style to repeat.

rules.name: The Lowercase Voice Rule
rules.body: Display, wordmark, labels, and buttons stay lowercase, as the copy is written. Don't apply text-transform and don't use uppercase tracking.

rules.name: The Quoted Label Rule
rules.body: Form labels are set in bold and wrapped in curly quotes, as though the visitor is saying them. This is a native device of the world, not decoration to strip out.

rules.name: The Flat Slab Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are solid fills on paper. When something needs emphasis, it gets ink or stone, not a shadow.

dos: Do keep the header, content, and footer on one left edge inside the 640px column with the shared gutter.
Do use gold only for the drawn four-point sparkle, with at most three decorative sparkles per screen, two on the stone block and one on the primary button.
Do render every ✨ in copy as the inline drawn sparkle, and keep the playful lowercase copy and its emoji voice intact.
Do set the display at 800 weight, lowercase, with tight leading (0.95) and tight tracking (-0.035em).
Do wrap field labels in curly quotes and use underline-only fields.
Do put primary actions in an ink pill (999px) with paper text.
Do honor reduced motion by making sparkles static.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass, backdrop blur, or glow, and don't use box-shadows for elevation.
Don't reintroduce mystic purple, cyan, pink, or starfield imagery, and don't drift into beige spa-zen.
Don't use red or terracotta in the interface palette.
Don't set any text in gold.
Don't use emoji or icon-font glyphs as UI icons. Icons are inline SVG in currentColor.
Don't put a sparkle on the wordmark.
Don't use more than one stone block per screen.
